lessons.title: Active and Passive Voice: Converting Between Tenses
lessons.content: Active Voice means that a sentence has a subject that acts upon its verb. Passive Voice means that the subject is a recipient of a verb's action. We can convert active voice to passive voice in many tenses.

details.explanation: Active: Subject + verb(s) + object. Passive: Object + am/is/are + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: Reporters write news reports. Passive: News reports are written by Reporters.
details.burmese: Simple Present Tense မှာ Active: Subject + verb(s) + object။ Passive: Object + am/is/are + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + verb-ed/past + object. Passive: Object + was/were + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: He wrote a letter. Passive: A letter was written.
details.burmese: Simple Past Tense မှာ Active: Subject + verb-ed/past + object။ Passive: Object + was/were + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + will + verb + object. Passive: Object + will + be + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: The company will hire new workers. Passive: New workers will be hired by the company.
details.burmese: Simple Future Tense မှာ Active: Subject + will + verb + object။ Passive: Object + will + be + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing + object. Passive: Object + am/is/are + being + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: A robot is serving food in this hotel. Passive: Food is being served by a robot in this hotel.
details.burmese: Present Continuous Tense မှာ Active: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing + object။ Passive: Object + am/is/are + being + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + was/were + verb-ing + object. Passive: Object + was/were + being + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: She was writing a novel. Passive: A novel was being written.
details.burmese: Past Continuous Tense မှာ Active: Subject + was/were + verb-ing + object။ Passive: Object + was/were + being + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + have/has + past participle + object. Passive: Object + have/has + been + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: They have already discussed the book. Passive: The book has already been discussed.
details.burmese: Present Perfect Tense မှာ Active: Subject + have/has + past participle + object။ Passive: Object + have/has + been + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + had + past participle + object. Passive: Object + had + been + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: He had delivered the letters. Passive: The letters had been delivered.
details.burmese: Past Perfect Tense မှာ Active: Subject + had + past participle + object။ Passive: Object + had + been + past participle (+ by subject)။

details.explanation: Active: Subject + will have + past participle + object. Passive: Object + will have + been + past participle (+ by subject).
details.example: Active: I will have written a letter. Passive: A letter will have been written.
details.burmese: Future Perfect Tense မှာ Active: Subject + will have + past participle + object။ Passive: Object + will have + been + past participle (+ by subject)။
